changes.title: Sail takeoff freeze
items: Taking off from the treehouse should no longer freeze, after a sail or not: the house seen from the air and your sigil stack are now prepared ahead

changes.title: Challenge hidden
items: The challenge circle stays hidden in the forest until the party starts, then fades in as its trees fade away; if it isn't won, it fades back into forest when the party's over

changes.title: Tree normals 32
items: Trees are shaded from a smaller set of light directions (32), close to before but lighter to draw.
The game no longer waits for the trees' shading to be worked out: trees start with their full shading and switch a moment after load.

changes.title: Statue spacing 10
items: Challenge statues stand closer together: the elder 10 m in from its column, the youth 10 m further.

changes.title: Wild look
items: New Wild look group on the pause page: her light's reach, brightness and colour in the wild, and a new colour grade that only shows in the wild (off at first)
